what: pairs of files that are near-identical but carry DIFFERENT artwork ids, i.e. duplicates the filename-derived ground truth does not know about

method.primary_arm_rationale: won the retrieval bake-off (R@1 0.7892); see bakeoff.json
method.scope_note: the census is computed independently on each finalist and then combined, so cross-arm agreement is MEASURED here rather than assumed. Counts headlined elsewhere are the primary arm's; the union and intersection below say how arm-dependent that is.
method.similarity: cosine; vectors are L2-normalized so this is a dot product
method.determinism: float64 accumulation, cosines rounded to 6 decimals before thresholding, output sorted
method.identity: artwork id is the 24-char suffix (sharded) or 32-hex stem (music-artworks); pairs sharing an id are EXCLUDED as already known

named_components.note: connected components of the near-dup graph at the primary threshold. A large component with many distinct artwork ids is template artwork or a heavily reissued cover, not an incidental pair.
